test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which tunnel connects Manali to Lahaul-Spiti Valley?

options.text: Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee Road Tunnel

solution:
The correct is__** Atal Road Tunnel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pir Panjal Railway Tunnel** is located in **Jammu and Kashmir** and connects** Banihal and Qazigund**. It is the longest railway tunnel in India.
 
• Atal Tunnel:
 
 
• On October 3, 2020, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the ‘Atal Tunnel’ the World’s Longest Highway Tunnel in Manali, Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The 9.02 Kilometre Long Tunnel has been constructed by the Border Roads Organisation (BRO) at a cost of INR 3, 300 crores.
 
• It connects Manali and Lahaul-Spiti Valley.
 
 
 
• **Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee Road Tunnel** is located in Jammu and Kashmir and connects Srinagar and Leh.
 
 
• It is the** longest road** tunnel in India.
 
 
 
• ** Karbude Railway Tunnel** is located in Maharashtra and is a part of the Konkan Railway.
 
 
• It is the longest railway tunnel on the **Konkan Railway line.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atal Road Tunnel**, also known as the Rohtang Tunnel, is located in Himachal Pradesh and connects Manali to Lahaul-Spiti Valley.
 
• It is the longest tunnel above 10,000 feet in the world.
 
• The tunnel is named after former **Prime Minister of India**, Atal Bihari Vajpayee, who laid the **foundation stone for the project in 2002.**
 
• The tunnel is a significant infrastructure development in the region as it provides all-weather connectivity to Lahaul-Spiti valley, which was earlier cut off from the rest of the country during winters due to heavy snowfall.
 
• The tunnel is expected to boost tourism in the region and also provide a strategic advantage to the **Indian Army in the border areas**.
